verdict.rationale: Twenty's docs describe workflows that trigger automatically on record changes, schedules, or incoming webhooks. Those workflows can chain record operations, HTTP requests, code, branches, iterators, delays, and AI Agent steps. The docs also describe AI agents that execute multi-step tasks autonomously within the permission model, so the core story is clearly delivered by first-party docs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that background workflows run reliably, and documentation of run monitoring, logs, or retry/error handling for unattended automations.
